Class PlanetPreviewPaneBuilder

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.planet.PlanetPreviewPaneBuilder
public class PlanetPreviewPaneBuilder extends Object
Autonomous UI Controller and Section Builder for Planetary Dynamic 2D Equirectangular Preview, Interactive Zoom/Pan, Color Palettes, Cartographic Legends, and Cosine-Weighted Ocean Ratios.

Extracted from PlanetGeneratorPanel to satisfy the Single Responsibility Principle (SRP). Computes cosine-weighted surface area ratios $\int \cos(\phi) \, d\phi$ to provide true spherical ocean vs land percentages decoupled from planar equirectangular distortion.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
